content: There's a place of deep fellowship with the Father, this place is the strongest refuge that you'll be at. When you totally open up to God where you are completely vulnerable to Him and all that He is, everything and everyone disappears in that moment. This is a man at His strongest laying prostrate in complete submission to the Love of God. There is a deep calling out to you, answer the upward call of God for you in Christ Jesus.

This is the day that the Lord has made. His mercies are new to you, with the dawning of the light God brings a new experience of life, you are brought into a place where you don't have to carry the baggage of yesterday. Jesus is the dawning of the light, He who follows Him shall not walk in darkness, the revelation of Christ is what you need, let His Word shine through. Therein is true and lasting freedom.

There is no shame in being true to where you are right now, God desires us to be content with where we are right now but not satisfied with the status quo. In your pursuit of God find contentment in all that He has given right now, acknowledge what is right before you and be thankful for it. Function to the full at your current position at work and ministry, as you reach out to the greatness that God has promised you, be effective right Here. You are in your way to the top by faithfulness.

You are solid Gold, you are more valuable than you think, you are a pure treasure of Heaven in the Earth. Never sale yourself short, refuse to settle for less. God is the one who has declared your value, He defines how much you are worth and He displays you to the world as a rare jewel, one of its kind. You are too precious to be depressed, sick, broke, hopeless, heartbroken etc, none of those things have a place on your path of life. You are pure gold! Show forth your worth, hold your head high, be confident show forth the Glory of the Lord.

The world needs a you, in the design of God He made us a solution to the world around us, He has given you the ability to shine in the world today! You are an asset to the kingdom, a solution to someone in distress. Don't be passive about your destiny. You must fulfil that call, that vision that you see is of God, and He has desired to use it to bless so many others. Stop looking for people's approval set your eyes on Jesus.

Jesus is the Lord of all things and that is a wonderful truth. He reigns supreme above all things, the divine ruler and sovereign King. The blessedness however is having Him as the Lord of your life, it's in yielding yourself to be led by Him, and be given to His Lordship, He is now in charge of all that concerns you. Jesus is the one now who decides and dictates that you are and the kind of life that you are to experience. He has decided that you are the righteousness of God in Christ, that you are blessed with all spiritual blessings in Heavenly places, that you are a shining the light and city set on a hill. Depression fear sickness and poverty, have no place in your life according to your Lord, He has decided a higher life for you.

In following Christ you have to swim against the current, the natural world around you has it's own setup of things and it's desire is to beat you into its mold of doing things. But God has called you to a spiritual life, a life that can't be understood by the world and its system. The Holy Spirit leads us into this experience and causes us to walk totally free of the world's criteria of living. You are the light of the world, don't stoop down to its level rather shine for them to see the work and power of God in and through you. Your path is different, you play by a different set of rules.

The power to change is in your ability to yield to the Word of God. This is contrary to most people's belief of trying to make the changes in their own strength. The soul cannot make spiritual changes, God is spirit and the only way to function at His level is allowing yourself to flow with His Spirit and submitting to His Word. The Word of God is Alive and Powerful, it is more than just instructions to live by, it is active power, anyone who exposes themselves to it will be changed. Give yourself wholly to the teaching of the Word of God, for whatever area of life you desire change and watch the Holy Spirit work in you.

The hand that holds you is greater than all, so many things may try to pull on you, desperate situation that weigh heavy on your heart and life, choices to be made, hearts that won't heal, waiting for the break to come. God however doesn't ask us to live in the waiting, We are with Him now, stop hoping for a change or wishing for the something good to come out of your situation. The Victory is in Christ, and you have been raised together with Him, you are reigning with Him now, this is more real than anything that could be happening around you at this moment, in Christ is your permanent position, nothing and no one can change that.

He is the Power of the Godhead, yet the most humble and kind Person you'll ever know, He is the essence of life, the force behind existence, yet the helper to the weak, the stand by, the great counsellor, He is the Holy Spirit!! He is God in the Earth, God indwelling man, unlimited life and vitality, yet He grieves over the small things that hurt you, He is affected by all that you go through, He feels what you feel, He understands you like no one can. The Gift of the Father to the Church, and the expression of God to the world through the Church. Desire to know Him more: Holy Spirit!

The Holy Spirit is the first person revealed to us in the Bible, it is Him who brooded over the waters in the beginning, making ready for the Word of God to bring all things into being. As you receive the vision of your life from the Lord the Holy Spirit in you bringing life and vitality to it, causing it to come to pass. You have all that you need to accomplish greatness, yield to Him today.

The gift of the Father to the Church is the Person of Holy Spirit. How wonderful this truth is, that God would send us the Holy Spirit to dwell in us. We have acknowledged that the Father gave us His Son Jesus, to die for us that we should not perish, but to a great degree few have come to terms with the truth that the Father sent the Holy Spirit to indwell us, He is the Power and presence of the God here with us and in us. He is Doing big things in you, bearing witness with your spirit that you are a child of God! Acknowledge Him today and experience His Power!

The Holy Spirit is the great Counsellor! You can be sure that for what ever decision you need to make He'll be right there with you. You never have to make a wrong decision, you never have to live you life unsure about the future, for your business, ministry, relationships, etc He will lead you into all truth. You never have to miss the mark, God desires you to be on point all the time. Trust the Great Counsellor today let will lead and guide you in the path of righteousness.

There are maybe some things that may push you off course, they may bring to a point of pain or grief, in these moments of weakness we all need comfort. The Holy Ghost is the Comforter, He is so gentle in dealing with us that His very presence is so reassuring and warm. He is not passive in the comfort that He gives, it's not merely a "things will get better" kind of comfort, the Holy Ghost dispels doubt and causes Faith to rise in you. He comforts you bringing the Word of God to light! Though He is gentle He comes in power to change your situation, the Comfort He brings is permanent and perfect, aligning your heart Great Comforter.

He is your Strength, there is power resident inside you. How can you say you are unable to do a task handed to you when the very power of the Godhead is at work in you! You can do all things through Christ who strengthens you! Christ in you is the person of the Holy Ghost! There is an anointing in you for exploits, you destined for great things! Success is assured in all that you do!

Time of prayer is never wasted, they are divine moments of Heaven and Earth colliding, so much is set into motion every time you pray. You may not see it now, but you allow angelic intervention into your life and all your endeavors, power is made available to effect changes into your life. The Holy Spirit in you makes the will of God clear to you and as you pray you speak words of Power! Your prayers are effective!

The Holy Spirit is your defense He never goes to sleep on anything that concerns you! Have you ever been in a place where you were accused falsely and needed someone to stand up for you? There's no need to be dismayed the Holy Ghost is your standby, He takes your affairs personal, He speaks on your behalf, trust Him and walk in Faith knowing He has all things in His charge!

You cannot in your own strength fulfil your calling, it's not about your will power, the call of God is known and fulfilled by the power of the Holy Ghost! Jesus couldn't not do the ministry that He did without the power of the Holy Ghost! That same Spirit is on the inside of you, doing big things in you, He is your strength, He is the Power for exploits, He is the God instinct in you! Walk in Faith, for Jesus assured us that the works that I do you shall do a greater works than these!!

There is a power that is made available to us, far beyond what mankind has discovered, more powerful than nuclear or atomic energy, it is the Power of the Holy Spirit! He is the Power that caused everything that exists to be brought into being when God spoke it! This power in resident in you, you are so loaded, you are a walking load possibility, you can bring forth wonders to manifest, by the power which is at work in you!

The power to change the Hearts of people in the Gospel of Jesus Christ! He accomplished a complete and perfect work, anyone who will align themselves with what the Lord did in His finished work will experience the full benefits of God's gift of Grace! Grace is a mighty power that converts the hearts of men and brings out the God nature in them. No one can change themselves, it's the working of the gift of Grace! Receive abundance of Grace for every area of your life.

Refuse to give doubt a foothold in your life, no matter how things may be looking around you, hold on to the Word of God! Let your faith rise higher than the exterior voices. Greater is He that is in you than He that is in the world. Voice your faith, speak the Word out loud, speak to the situation, declare the victory that is yours in Christ! Keep your eyes on Jesus, He is your reality!

That smile is all some people need, the atmosphere of Joy brings out the best in others! Joy is a mighty fortress against the on slot of the enemy. It is the hallmark of the Kingdom of God, we live in a culture of Joy. Jesus calls us to walk in His Joy! It brightens up the lives of others around us, and invites the angelic ministry in our affairs. The light of God has dawned on your life, You don't walk in darkness the day has dawned, Joy come in the morning! This is your life!

The tree that stands tall and proud today was once a small tender sprout out of the ground! With time and consistency it become what it is today! What seems to be a mere sprout today with the right nurture and care becomes a great destiny that inspires and encourages many! Stay true to what has been committed to you it may seem little today but stay focused on it, tomorrow the Lord will use you as an example of His strength tomorrow! You are a great Destiny waiting to manifest to the World!

You are not from here, you don't originate from the Earth, you were sent here by God Almighty to bring about the touch of Heaven on Earth! You are a divine being sent here to accomplish and establish the Kingdom of God! You are in the world but you are not of it! When you gave your life to Christ you were called out of the World! You are the light bringing hope to the world, have the giver mindset, bless the world around, impart life and light everywhere today!

The most that you can get out of life is more about how much of yourself that you pour out than what you amass, so many are unsatisfied despite all the things they have earned. God designed the world to work best for those who pour into it than for those who take from it! God is a giver, and you and I were created in His image and likeness! It not about what life hasn't given you, but it's about you pouring yourself into life. This is the mentality for success and fulfilment in your Church, work, marriage relationships, family and every sphere of interaction. You are called to be a blessing!

The greatest revelation that one can have of God is that He is our Father, when Jesus taught His disciples to pray He said for them to pray "Our Father". This is so significant, firstly it speaks of our intimacy with God, how the servant relationship that most be people try to propagate is not the truest picture of what we are in Christ! Secondly when we say "Our Father" we declare that we as Believers are brothers and sisters! We are one in Christ!

The best things in life are in Christ! The fullness that any man can attain is what is made available to us in Christ! Jesus is God's picture of what we are called to be, completely victorious and reigning in life! If there is any area of your life that is not yet consistent with this truth, keep looking at Him and refuse to settle for less! Until the truth is made manifest in you that As He Is so are you! This is the call of God for you!

Everyone has a soft spot for the people they love and have endowed affection to, we are willing to drop all else for a moment with these people. This is how dear you are to Jesus, He loves you passionately, His eyes are always upon you, His ears are always inclined to you! You are the beloved of the Lord, and all the kingdom of Heaven recognises the privilege that you hold in the Kings eyes, He is constantly speaking of His Love for you! You are not a peasant in the Kingdom, you are the Kings beloved, and every stars knows it! Smile lift your head high you are prized by Majesty!

We are very sure and accustomed to the inheritance that we have in Christ, and rightfully so, there is so much that Hideous made available to us in Christ! Yet on the other hand we need to also be aware of the inheritance that God has in us, we have something in us that belongs to God and we owe it to Him to bring it out! Now this is not speaking of religious laws to follow and earn something, it's bringing the purposes of God to pass! The children of Israel, we're carrying the Sees of Christ in them, so they owed it to God to enter into the promiseland, the same is true with us, Creation is groaning for us to manifest as son's and we owe it to God!

Focus on the things that God has given you to do, these are the areas of your strength, this is where you will shine and subdue! Set your priorities right, be strongest in the things that bring you closer to your destiny. Every step along the journey counts, celebrate every victory no matter how small, those are the things that make your life worth while, be intentional about breaking out of your comfort zone! Jesus is calling you to a greater experience reach out for this higher life!

God is always mindful of you, your life is ever before Him, He is very much aware of what is happening in and around your life! His provision and blessing are available ever step of your way! Keep moving fully aware of His presence all around you, take that leap of Faith into the unknown knowing all too well that His Word is a lamp unto your feet, He will not let your foot stumble you will shine and make it! He is with you, even in those decisions that seem so unclear, look to Him, He is your light and strength!

Have you ever gotten to a place where you have Dreams begin to look hazy, something that you were once so sure of begins to look unclear? You have no more strength to pursue it, or other things have taken your eyes off the main thing? The Lord today is restoring vision He is restoring vision of all that He spoke to you He is bringing you to a real working interaction with destiny! It's going to be more than ideas or mere thoughts, He is bringing you down destiny paths, walk in them be faithful at every stage! Embrace the right connections God has brought you into a blessed life! Dreams are coming to life.

Decisions; they make the difference between life and death, all throughout your life you will be called to the bench of decision, everyone who ever did anything had to pass through there. When God made us He gave us the ability to choose! Your life will not progress without choices, you need to make choices, others shun making decision and just let circumstances decide where life takes them, refuse to be carried by the wind, take ownership of your life today! You have the mind of Christ! You are graced to make the right decisions,be bold today make those decisions, no matter how drastic, your future is in the other side of your sound decisions!

Your revelation of God is so important, everything that comes your way goes through the filter of the God you know! It's a personal reality of God in your own life! Who is the God that you worship, we may call Him the same name but what is your personal revelation of and relationship with Him. One man can have many relationships; classmates, spouse, children, business partners, bosses, servants etc, the same man relates to various people depending on their relationship with them, same thing with God, there is One God but various people relate with Him differently! Study the Word and get to know Him for yourself, embrace the Truth that is revealed to you and walk in the Light!

When it comes to decisions and making choices it's always important to decide based on adequate knowledge, this is how to we can ensure that we are making the right choice! The Bible tells us of how we are a chosen generation, God who is omniscient IN His perfect knowledge and wisdom chose you! You are the choice of the Lord this show you how valuable you are! Show forth His excellence!

There is so much that happens when we yield to God in unity, there is much that can be accomplished as an individual but there are things in God that we exclusively released over the cooperate body of Christ! As we step into the blessedness of Unity there coming a mighty release of the Glory of God that has never been before! We are a body, not an organization but the Living Body of Christ! Psa 133.

Jesus in John 17 prayed a very important prayer for the church, He said that we maybe one just as He and the Father are one, there is a call of unity that we have as a Church! The walls of denominations are falling and a Perfect Church is emerging in power and glory! As we manifest our oneness in the power of the Love of God, Creation itself will respond in Resurrection glory! They know us by our Love!

When we speak of Unity, many immediately think of conformity, but the plan of God has never been conformity, just as the whole body is not an eye or a hand, the Unity in Christ is not about us all doing or teaching the same thing, it's about each one fulfilling and pursuing the fullness of thier call! Let's not unify on the basic level of spirituality. But rather on the highest level, let the eyes be the eyes, let the hands be the hands let every part reach its fullness and manifest Christ to the full!

There is power in oneness when the Lord revealed Himself to Israel He said "Hear oh Israel the Lord your God the Lord is One". We who are in His Likeness bear this unity, it is oneness with God and oneness with each other! We have all been made to drink into one Spirit! This blessed unity is unbeatable, we the Church are an unstoppable force. We are rising up and taking territory establishing the Kingdom of God on the Earth in Power!

We are one, we need each other, the Body of Christ is a real living being and Jesus is the head, and our accountability is to Him and Him alone. That we don't understand each other doesn't give us the right to despise or look down on the other person. Doctrine has never been higher than Love of God that binds us together. We are more one than our understanding of scriptures. Love is the biggest motivation of all that we are and do! We are one body before we have differing opinions on understanding God's Word!

The Power of oneness is the revelation of the Holy Spirit indwelling every believer. He is not divided amongst Christians, He indwell each individual completely. No one has more Holy Spirit than the other. He dwells in the believer in totality, you are His temple, when we realise this, it makes us love each other beyond denomination, Culture and understanding, we see Christ in the individual and embrace each other as brothers and sisters. We have a God bond that is stronger than physical birth, we are not just family we are one.

God is over all things He is the Higher than any revelation or Understanding that we may have of Him, all that we are is found in the Him! God does not come to take sides, He comes to take over. Jesus is all in all, He is Lord at every level of mountain of God! Ours is to realise this and connect with each other and every level of fellowship! We are born of Love and for Love, Love takes over all things! Psa 133.

The Love revolution is the next coming move of God! There is no enemy that shall stop the power of oneness in the Bond of Love! Jesus prayed that we may be one just as He and the Father are one! This oneness is a mystery, we are so distinct in function yet one in purpose, united by a bond that is beyond the comprehension of the mind! Just as the revelation of the Trinity, so are we a powerful diverse unit with one purpose, and it is in all of us fulfilling our individual assignments that the overall assignment of the body is fulfilled! We are one body!

The biggest motivation of a believer is Love, this is the working of the Holy Spirit inside each of us! We are patient, we are kind, we delight in the truth, we are not puffed up with pride, we don't seek our own. The Love of God is shade abroad in our hearts by the Holy Spirit who was given unto us! We are born of Love, we show forth God in all that we do!

Stay the course don't wander off the assignment the Lord has given you, follow along step by step, fulfill the ministry given you of the Lord! Declare that message to the whole world, they need it! Do not relent, do not back down. The work is of the Lord He will surely back you up! Fulfill your assignment, it may look small now but the Lord is taking you higher into levels of a fruitful and fulfilled life with Him. Keep the course and refuse to be swayed, Looking on to Jesus!

It's possible to walk out in the fullness of the greatness that you have inside you! Refuse to be mediocre and stereotypical! You were made to stand out, push alittle harder, speak alittle louder, the ideas you have are what will change the world if you would allow the Grace of God to function in you! God has placed so much in you, and by the power of the Holy Spirit you are able to do exceedingly great things that will bring great change to the world! Creation waits for you, shine forth your light manifest the Glory of the Lord! You were made for Great things walk in them!

Your call is sure, God makes no mistakes it's Him who placed those dreams in your heart! If you will walk before Him he will empower you to fulfil them all! The gifts and the callings of God are without repentance, He formed you for good works before the foundation of the World! The answer to suffering of humanity is people living up to their highest potential! Rise up to the challenge, you were born for it! His Grace is sufficient for you!

Stand up for what you believe in. When the Lord brings revelation to your heart, when the eyes of your understanding are enlightened it is up to you to make that your truth! Begin confessing that truth as your reality. Jesus is the Word, and when light comes it is your understanding being made aware of who Jesus is, then begin to see yourself in Him, see that word fulfilled in your life and refuse anything less! Walk in that light!

Jesus' heart is always for restoration and redemption. He never condemns anyone, He lifts the Lost and needy out of despair and worry! That's His nature He is the Savior! No one comes in contact with Jesus and leaves the same, He is a life giving spirit, no matter what state they are in, one touch one word, one encounter is all it takes to turn the vilest of sinners into a saint, the hardest of struggles is turned into complete victory! This is the power of Life in Christ Jesus!

Have a tenacity for the things you desire in Life, don't just let life happen to you, take charge and control over your life! The Holy Spirit enables us to focus on what matters as He leads us into all truth. You are called to fulfil great things and yours is to walk in the Light of what is revealed to you now! Stay focused it shall come to pass!
